## Introduction

```{r}
#| title: create-data

library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

flights <- data.frame(
  Airline = c("ALASKA", "ALASKA", "AM WEST", "AM WEST"),
  Status  = c("on time", "delayed", "on time", "delayed"),
  `Los Angeles`   = c(497, 62, 694, 117),
  Phoenix         = c(221, 12, 4840, 415),
  `San Diego`     = c(212, 20, 383, 65),
  `San Francisco` = c(503, 102, 320, 129),
  Seattle         = c(1841, 305, 201, 61),
  check.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(flights, "flight_delays.csv")

```

```{r}
#| title: tidy-data

tidy_flights <- pivot_longer(
  flights, cols = -c(Airline, Status), 
  names_to = "City", values_to = "Flights" )

tidy_flights |> 
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "Flight info")

by_city <- tidy_flights |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Status, values_from = Flights) |>
  mutate(Total = `on time` + delayed,
         Pct_on_time = round(100 * `on time` / Total, 2),
         Pct_delayed = round(100 * delayed / Total, 2))

overall <- by_city |>
  group_by(Airline) |>
  summarise(on_time = sum(`on time`), delayed = sum(delayed),
            Total = on_time + delayed,
            Pct_on_time = round(100 * on_time / Total, 2),
            Pct_delayed = round(100 * delayed / Total, 2))


by_city |> select(Airline, City, Pct_on_time) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Airline, values_from = Pct_on_time)
```
